driver-layers.title: Three layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls the hardware-agnostic BMP581 driver, which reads and writes registers through the CRTP register transport, which calls the platform port you write, which drives the I2C or SPI bus of the BMP581.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your application talks to one bmp581::Driver<Bus> object, whose public calls are listed from inc/bmp581_driver.hpp. Each call becomes register reads and writes in the order the datasheet requires (the standby hop, IIR writes in standby, POR and NVM checks). The register transport (BusInterface in inc/bmp581_bus_interface.hpp) is a CRTP base with four methods. The platform port is the only code you write: a class that implements them over I2C or SPI. Below it is the sensor.
